notes.title: Add 6 more languages at this time.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795704/fbe3b5877594563ecb7184c24602c45f46203962.png[/img]
Add Six more languages this time.
Now this game supports languages as follows,[b] Thai, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Korean, Japanese, Finnish, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Italian, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, Danish[/b]. More other languages will also be added in the future.

notes.title: New Languages now supported.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795704/b0290fb61e90e1daba5c11a502e7d32624cf7c74.png[/img]
New Languages now supported. Bugs fixed. Linux(SteamOS) and Mac supported. A fantastic sound bar were added.
Languages now fully supported are:
Thai, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French,
German, Korean, Japanese, Finnish, Dutch, Polish.
However, we are still working on adding more languages.
